Class Dog1

java.lang.Object
models.base.Unit
models.base.SingleTargetUnit
models.enemies.Dog1
All Implemented Interfaces:
Attackable, Moveable
public class Dog1 extends SingleTargetUnit
The basic enemy dog unit — low HP, light damage, single-target.

Stats: 150 HP | 4 damage | 2000 ms cooldown | 50 px range | +3 speed (moves right).
